Summary: This update refines the documentation and options for the Eversince creative agent skill.

- Updated and clarified the agent’s description, focusing on image, video, and audio (slimmer text, removed “motion graphics” in the main description).
- Expanded and revised the “Project Options,” now allowing a `skills` array to activate multiple Eversince or custom skills.
- Added new field options (`skills`, `reasoning_mode`), and documented their purpose and defaults.
- Refined language and formatting throughout for better clarity and accuracy.
- Kept requirements, workflow steps, and agent capabilities up-to-date with recent feature support.
